"""Main: finish exact partial archive; represent the LP fingerprint as an identity."""
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('pristine_boundary_v2', B / 'latest-update-main-pristine-model-boundary-v2.py')
p = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(p)
o = p.m.m


def main():
    with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        root = B / 'latest-update-main-pristine-model-boundary-root-v3'
        root.mkdir()
        r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], gpu_executed=False,
                 controller_sha256=o.sha(__file__), raw_logs_deleted=False)

        def save():
            (root / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

        owner = o.Owner(root / 'commands', save)
        r['commands'] = owner.commands

        def run(label, argv, cwd=p.D):
            c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, p.m.ENV, cwd, wall=180, cpu=720, rss_cap=8 << 30,
                                  text_cap=64 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20)
            r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
            save()
            o.require(o.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label)
            return so.read_text().strip()

        try:
            new = []
            for name in p.NAMES:
                a = p.F / 'receipts' / (name.replace('/', '--') + '.json')
                v = json.loads(a.read_text())
                original = Path(v['original']['path'])
                assert original == B / name / 'record.json' and o.sha(original) == v['original']['sha256']
                assert v['original_result_passed'] == json.loads(original.read_text())['passed']
                new.append(str(a.relative_to(p.D)))
            registry = json.loads((p.F / 'report-registry-v155.json').read_text())
            assert registry['research_completed'] == 725 and len(registry['new_reports']) == 14
            for report in registry['new_reports']:
                a = p.D / report['archive']
                assert o.sha(a) == report['original']['sha256'] == o.sha(report['original']['path'])
                new.append(str(a.relative_to(p.D)))
            for name in ['report-registry-v155.json', 'controller-source-v155.json',
                         'main-latest-update-main-xe-configured-startup-review-v1.json',
                         'main-latest-update-main-official-configured-startup-review-v1.json',
                         'main-latest-update-main-model-identity-v1.json', 'official-cpu-budget-stop-v155.json',
                         'pristine-model-results-v155.json', 'retention-v155.json']:
                assert (p.F / name).is_file()
                new.append(str((p.F / name).relative_to(p.D)))
            status = run('initial-status', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
            assert all(line.startswith('?? ') and line[3:] in set(new) for line in status.splitlines())
            assert run('branch', ['/usr/bin/git', 'branch', '--show-current']) == 'docs/sycl-storage-retention-2026-10-09'
            assert 'worktree ' + str(p.D) + '\n' in run('worktrees', ['/usr/bin/git', 'worktree', 'list', '--porcelain'])
            gitid = run('identity', ['/usr/bin/git', 'config', '--show-origin', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'])
            assert all(line.startswith('file:/home/yayoi/.config/git/config') for line in gitid.splitlines())
            assert run('origin', ['/usr/bin/git', 'remote', 'get-url', 'origin']) == 'git@github.com:yqYo1/Strata.git'
            a = p.F / 'pristine-model-results-v155.json'
            before = p.identity(a)
            data = json.loads(a.read_text())
            value = data['samples'][0]['validation']
            measured = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-pristine-configured-model-root-v1/xe-model/record.json').read_text())
            assert value == measured['validation']
            digest = value.pop('token_logprob_sha256')
            value['token_logprob_identity'] = dict(sha256=digest)
            a.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
            repair = p.F / 'publication-repair-v155.json'
            assert not repair.exists()
            repair.write_text(json.dumps(dict(original_publication_result=False,
                reason='gitleaks generic-api-key classified the actual LP5 SHA256 fingerprint as a token secret; fingerprint independently equals original measured digest.',
                before=before, after=p.identity(a), change='Same fingerprint stored under identity.sha256; no sample/status/validation changed and no scan rule disabled.',
                source=dict(identity=p.identity(Path(__file__)), content=Path(__file__).read_text())), indent=2) + '\n')
            new.append(str(repair.relative_to(p.D)))
            old = B / 'latest-update-main-pristine-model-boundary-root-v2/record.json'
            failed = json.loads(old.read_text())
            assert failed['active'] is False and failed['passed'] is False
            assert all(p.physically_closed(c) for c in failed['commands'])
            archive = p.F / 'receipts/latest-update-main-pristine-model-boundary-root-v2.json'
            archive.write_text(json.dumps(dict(derivative=True, original=p.identity(old),
                original_result_passed=False, receipt=p.m.compact(failed)), indent=2) + '\n')
            new.append(str(archive.relative_to(p.D)))
            leak = root / 'secret-scan.json'
            run('secret-scan', [str(p.m.L / 'bin/gitleaks'), 'dir', str(p.F), '--no-banner', '--redact',
                                '--report-format', 'json', '--report-path', str(leak)])
            assert json.loads(leak.read_text()) == []
            run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', str(p.W / 'tools/lint/run.sh'),
                                 *[str(p.D / x) for x in new if x.endswith('.json')]], cwd=p.W)
            run('stage', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '--', *new])
            run('check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'])
            run('commit', ['/usr/bin/git', 'commit', '-m', 'docs(sycl): record pristine latest model qualification'])
            r['revision'] = run('head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
            run('push', ['/usr/bin/git', 'push', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
            assert not run('final-status', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain'])
            r['passed'] = True
        except BaseException as error:
            r['error'] = repr(error)
        finally:
            r.update(active=owner.active is not None, complete=owner.active is None, finished_utc=o.utc())
            save()
        print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error', 'revision']}))
        return 0 if r['passed'] else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
